extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: minivan (MPV, family van), approx. 4.9 x 1.9 x 1.9 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.70 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; sliding door on the right side (minivan_sliding_door, with its own window) is a separate object with origin at its front lower edge: move it about 0.06 m outwards (-X) and up to 0.9 m towards the rear (+Y) to open; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cabin with transparent windows and three seat rows; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
